segments.title: karma and the two worlds

spans.eng: the two worlds [of beings and the place they live]

spans.tib: sems tsam gyi gzhung du yang bshad pas
spans.eng: books of the Mind-Only School also discuss

spans.tib: sems tsam gyi lugs la'ang snod kyi 'jig rten med pa min no
spans.eng: it's not as though the system of the Mind Only denies the existence of the world where beings live.
